اقتطفن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَطَفْنَ (iqtaṭafna) /iq.ta.tˤaf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# اُقْتُطِفْنَ (uqtuṭifna) /uq.tu.tˤif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# اِقْتَطِفْنَ (iqtaṭifna) /iq.ta.tˤif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
